### Uploading and Preparing the Data
```{r}
# Uploading
sites_ever_treated <- read_csv('../data/output/intersection_intervention_table_final_w_geo.csv', show_col_types = FALSE)
sites_ever_treated <- as.data.table(sites_ever_treated)
```

### General Cleaning and Setup 
```{r}
# 1. Summarize Interventions and Years
intervention_cols <- c(
  "leading_pedestrian_interval_post", "turn_traffic_calming_post", 
  "speed_limit_post", "slow_zones_post", "enhanced_crossing_post", 
  "signal_retiming_post", "speed_humps_post", 
  "street_improvement_project_post", "street_improvement_corridors_post"
)

nice_names <- c(
  "LPI", "Turn Calming", "Speed Limit", "Slow Zone", 
  "Enhanced Crossing", "Signal Retiming", "Speed Humps", 
  "SIP Intersections", "SIP Corridors"
)

# Find when each intervention was turned on per intersection
interventions_summary <- sites_ever_treated %>%
  select(intersection_id, year, all_of(intervention_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(intervention_cols), names_to = "intervention", values_to = "status") %>%
  filter(status == 1) %>%
  group_by(intersection_id, intervention) %>%
  summarize(turn_on_year = min(year), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    nice_name = nice_names[match(intervention, intervention_cols)],
    label = paste0(nice_name, " (", turn_on_year, ")")
  ) %>%
  group_by(intersection_id) %>%
  summarize(
    total_unique_interventions = n(),
    interventions_str = paste(label, collapse = "<br>")
  )

# 2. Calculate Casualties for 13/14 and 22/23
cas_summary <- sites_ever_treated %>%
  mutate(period = case_when(
    year %in% c(2013, 2014) ~ "start_cas",
    year %in% c(2022, 2023) ~ "end_cas",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(period)) %>%
  group_by(intersection_id, period) %>%
  summarize(cas = sum(pedestrian_death_or_injury, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = period, values_from = cas, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(
    raw_reduction = start_cas - end_cas,
    pct_reduction = ifelse(start_cas > 0, (start_cas - end_cas) / start_cas * 100, NA)
  )

# 3. Extract unique geometries and create a master spatial dataframe
sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE) # Avoid errors with spatial intersections
master_sf <- sites_ever_treated %>%
  distinct(intersection_id, intersection_geom) %>%
  filter(!is.na(intersection_geom)) %>%
  # Read the WKT 
  sf::st_as_sf(wkt = "intersection_geom", crs = 2263) %>%
  # Fix any self-intersecting polygons
  sf::st_make_valid() %>%
  # Extract centroid for clean mapping
  sf::st_centroid() %>% 
  # Convert to lat/long for Leaflet
  sf::st_transform(4326) %>%
  # Join with casualty and intervention summaries
  left_join(cas_summary, by = "intersection_id") %>%
  left_join(interventions_summary, by = "intersection_id") %>%
  mutate(
    interventions_str = ifelse(is.na(interventions_str), "None", interventions_str),
    total_unique_interventions = ifelse(is.na(total_unique_interventions), 0, total_unique_interventions)
  )
# Turn spherical geometry back on for the rest of analysis
sf::sf_use_s2(TRUE)
```

### Reverse Geocoding
```{r}
# 1. Identify the unique intersections to geocode (Max 40)
# Pull the Top 20 Raw IDs
ids_raw <- master_sf %>%
  arrange(desc(raw_reduction)) %>%
  slice(1:20) %>%
  pull(intersection_id)

# Pull the Top 20 Pct IDs
ids_pct <- master_sf %>%
  filter(start_cas >= 2) %>% 
  arrange(desc(pct_reduction), desc(raw_reduction)) %>%
  slice(1:20) %>%
  pull(intersection_id)

# Combine and get unique IDs 
ids_to_geocode <- unique(c(ids_raw, ids_pct)) # 39 in total

# Filter spatial dataframe to these IDs
intersections_to_geocode <- master_sf %>%
  filter(intersection_id %in% ids_to_geocode) %>%
  select(intersection_id, intersection_geom)

# 2. Extract lat/long from the sf geometry column
coords <- st_coordinates(intersections_to_geocode)
intersections_to_geocode <- intersections_to_geocode %>%
  mutate(
    lon = coords[, 1],
    lat = coords[, 2]
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

# 3. Reverse-geocode 
geocoded_results <- intersections_to_geocode %>%
  reverse_geocode(
    lat = lat,
    long = lon,
    method = "osm",
    full_results = TRUE
  )

# 4. Clean up the API output
geocoded_clean <- geocoded_results %>%
  mutate(
    borough_proxy = coalesce(suburb, "NYC"),
    street = coalesce(road, name, "Unknown Street"),
    zip_code = coalesce(postcode, "No Zip"),
    location_label = paste0(street, ", ", borough_proxy, " (Zip: ", zip_code, ")")
  ) %>%
  select(intersection_id, location_label)

# 5. Join these text labels back to our master_sf
master_sf <- master_sf %>%
  left_join(geocoded_clean, by = "intersection_id") %>%
  mutate(location_label = ifelse(is.na(location_label), "Not Geocoded", location_label))
```

### 1. Top 20 Intersections by Raw Reduction
```{r}
top20_raw <- master_sf %>%
  arrange(desc(raw_reduction)) %>%
  slice(1:20)

# Datatable Output 
DT::datatable(
  top20_raw %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% 
    select(intersection_id, location_label, start_cas, end_cas, raw_reduction, interventions_str),
  colnames = c("Intersection ID", "Approx. Location", "2013/14 Cas.", "2022/23 Cas.", "Reduction", "Interventions"),
  escape = FALSE, 
  options = list(pageLength = 5)
)

# Leaflet Map 
leaflet(top20_raw) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    radius = 6, color = "blue", stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 0.8,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>Intersection ID:</b> ", intersection_id, "<br>",
      "<b>Location:</b> ", location_label, "<br><br>",
      "<b>2013/14 Casualties:</b> ", start_cas, "<br>",
      "<b>2022/23 Casualties:</b> ", end_cas, "<br>",
      "<b>Reduction:</b> ", raw_reduction, "<br><br>",
      "<b>Interventions:</b><br>", interventions_str
    )
  )
```

### 2. Top 20 Intersections by % Reduction
```{r}
top20_pct <- master_sf %>%
  filter(start_cas >= 2) %>% 
  arrange(desc(pct_reduction), desc(raw_reduction)) %>%
  slice(1:20)

# Datatable Output 
datatable(
  top20_pct %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% 
    select(intersection_id, location_label, start_cas, end_cas, pct_reduction, interventions_str) %>%
    mutate(pct_reduction = round(pct_reduction, 1)),
  colnames = c("Intersection ID", "Approx. Location", "2013/14 Cas.", "2022/23 Cas.", "% Reduction", "Interventions"),
  escape = FALSE,

)

# Leaflet Map 
leaflet(top20_pct) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%

      "<b>2013/14 Casualties:</b> ", start_cas, "<br>",
      "<b>2022/23 Casualties:</b> ", end_cas, "<br>",
      "<b>% Reduction:</b> ", round(pct_reduction, 1), "%<br><br>",
      "<b>Interventions:</b><br>", interventions_str
    )
  )
```

### Setup Council Districts & Spatial Join
```{r}
# Pull CD Geometries (councilcount)
vars <- c('DP02_0068E') 
cd_geo <- councilcount::get_geo_estimates(
  acs_year = "2022", 
  geo = "councildist", 
  var_codes = vars, 
  boundary_year = "2023"
) %>% 
  st_transform(4326) %>% 
  st_make_valid() %>%
  mutate(councildist = str_pad(as.character(councildist), width = 2, side = "left", pad = "0")) %>%
  select(councildist, geometry)

# Spatial join intersections centroids to CDs
intersections_with_cd <- st_join(master_sf, cd_geo, join = st_intersects) %>%
  filter(!is.na(councildist)) # Remove intersections falling outside NYC borders/water

# Aggregate casualty data and interventions up to the CD level
cd_summary <- intersections_with_cd %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(councildist) %>%
  summarize(
    total_intersections = n(),
    start_cas = sum(start_cas, na.rm = TRUE),
    end_cas = sum(end_cas, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_interventions = sum(total_unique_interventions, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    raw_reduction = start_cas - end_cas,
    pct_reduction = ifelse(start_cas > 0, (start_cas - end_cas) / start_cas * 100, NA)
  )

# Join back to CD geometries for mapping
cd_sf <- cd_geo %>%
  left_join(cd_summary, by = "councildist")
```

### 3. Council Districts by Raw Reduction
```{r}
# Jenks breaks for Leaflet legend
brks_raw <- classIntervals(cd_sf$raw_reduction, n = 5, style = "jenks")$brks
pal_raw <- colorBin("YlOrRd", domain = cd_sf$raw_reduction, bins = brks_raw, reverse = FALSE)

# Datatable
datatable(
  cd_sf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% arrange(desc(raw_reduction)) %>% 
    select(councildist, start_cas, end_cas, raw_reduction),
  colnames = c("Council District", "2013/14 Casualties", "2022/23 Casualties", "Raw Reduction")
)

# Leaflet Map
leaflet(cd_sf) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal_raw(raw_reduction),
    weight = 1, opacity = 1, color = "white", dashArray = "3", fillOpacity = 0.7,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>Council District:</b> ", councildist, "<br>",
      "<b>Raw Reduction:</b> ", raw_reduction, " casualties<br>",
      "<b>2013/14:</b> ", start_cas, " | <b>2022/23:</b> ", end_cas
    )
  ) %>%
  addLegend(pal = pal_raw, values = ~raw_reduction, opacity = 0.7, title = "Raw Casualty<br>Reduction", position = "bottomright")
```

### 5. Normalized Analysis 
```{r}
cd_normalized <- cd_sf %>%
  mutate(
    # Metric 1: Raw Drop per 100 Interventions installed in the CD
    casualties_prevented_per_100_int = (raw_reduction / total_interventions) * 100,
    # Metric 2: Intervention Intensity (Avg interventions per intersection in the CD)
    intervention_intensity = total_interventions / total_intersections,
    # Metric 3: Percentage points dropped per average intersection in CD
    pct_drop_per_unit_intensity = pct_reduction / intervention_intensity
  )

# Datatable
datatable(
  cd_normalized %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% 
    arrange(desc(pct_drop_per_unit_intensity)) %>%
    select(councildist, total_intersections, total_interventions, intervention_intensity, casualties_prevented_per_100_int, pct_drop_per_unit_intensity) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 2))),
  colnames = c("CD", "Intersections", "Total Interventions", "Intensity (Ints/Intersection)", "Cas. Reduced per 100 Ints", "% Drop per Unit Intensity")
)

# Leaflet Map
brks_norm <- classIntervals(cd_normalized$pct_drop_per_unit_intensity, n = 5, style = "jenks")$brks
pal_norm <- colorBin("Purples", domain = cd_normalized$pct_drop_per_unit_intensity, bins = unique(brks_norm))

leaflet(cd_normalized) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal_norm(pct_drop_per_unit_intensity),
    weight = 1, opacity = 1, color = "white", dashArray = "3", fillOpacity = 0.7,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>Council District:</b> ", councildist, "<br>",
      "<b>Intensity:</b> ", round(intervention_intensity, 2), " interventions/intersection<br>",
      "<b>% Drop / Intensity:</b> ", round(pct_drop_per_unit_intensity, 1), "<br>",
      "<i>(Higher means more efficient % drop relative to intervention volume)</i>"
    )
  ) %>%
  addLegend(pal = pal_norm, values = ~pct_drop_per_unit_intensity, opacity = 0.7, title = "Normalized Efficacy<br>(% Drop / Intensity)", position = "bottomright")
```

### Final Map
```{r}
# 1. Prepare Intersections Layer 
ids_raw <- top20_raw$intersection_id
ids_pct <- top20_pct$intersection_id

top_intersections <- master_sf %>%
  filter(intersection_id %in% c(ids_raw, ids_pct)) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      intersection_id %in% ids_raw & intersection_id %in% ids_pct ~ "Both Lists",
      intersection_id %in% ids_raw ~ "Top 20 Raw",
      intersection_id %in% ids_pct ~ "Top 20 %"
    )
  )

# Color palette for intersection markers
pal_markers <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("#800080", "#0000FF", "#008000"), # Purple, Blue, Green
  levels = c("Both Lists", "Top 20 Raw", "Top 20 %")
)

# 2. Ensure CD Palettes/Breaks are ready
brks_raw <- classIntervals(cd_normalized$raw_reduction, n = 5, style = "jenks")$brks
pal_raw <- colorBin("YlOrRd", domain = cd_normalized$raw_reduction, bins = unique(brks_raw))

brks_pct <- classIntervals(cd_normalized$pct_reduction, n = 5, style = "jenks")$brks
pal_pct <- colorBin("Blues", domain = cd_normalized$pct_reduction, bins = unique(brks_pct))

brks_norm <- classIntervals(cd_normalized$pct_drop_per_unit_intensity, n = 5, style = "jenks")$brks
pal_norm <- colorBin("Purples", domain = cd_normalized$pct_drop_per_unit_intensity, bins = unique(brks_norm))

# 3. Build the Master Leaflet Map
leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  
  # --- MAP PANES (Forces layer ordering so markers are always on top) ---
  addMapPane("cd_polygons", zIndex = 400) %>%
  addMapPane("intersections", zIndex = 410) %>%
  
  # --- LAYER 1: Raw Reduction (CDs) ---
  addPolygons(
    data = cd_normalized, group = "CD: Raw Reduction",
    fillColor = ~pal_raw(raw_reduction),
    weight = 1, opacity = 1, color = "white", dashArray = "3", fillOpacity = 0.7,
    options = pathOptions(pane = "cd_polygons"),
    popup = ~paste0("<b>Council District:</b> ", councildist, "<br><b>Raw Reduction:</b> ", raw_reduction, " casualties")
  ) %>%
  
  # --- LAYER 2: % Reduction (CDs) ---
  addPolygons(
    data = cd_normalized, group = "CD: % Reduction",
    fillColor = ~pal_pct(pct_reduction),
    weight = 1, opacity = 1, color = "white", dashArray = "3", fillOpacity = 0.7,
    options = pathOptions(pane = "cd_polygons"),
    popup = ~paste0("<b>Council District:</b> ", councildist, "<br><b>% Reduction:</b> ", round(pct_reduction, 1), "%")
  ) %>%
  
  # --- LAYER 3: Normalized Efficacy (CDs) ---
  addPolygons(
    data = cd_normalized, group = "CD: Normalized Efficacy",
    fillColor = ~pal_norm(pct_drop_per_unit_intensity),
    weight = 1, opacity = 1, color = "white", dashArray = "3", fillOpacity = 0.7,
    options = pathOptions(pane = "cd_polygons"),
    popup = ~paste0("<b>Council District:</b> ", councildist, "<br><b>Normalized Drop/Intensity:</b> ", round(pct_drop_per_unit_intensity, 1))
  ) %>%
  
  # --- OVERLAY ---
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = top_intersections, group = "Top Intersections",
    radius = 6, color = "black", weight = 1, # Added a black outline so they pop
    fillColor = ~pal_markers(category), stroke = TRUE, fillOpacity = 1,
    options = pathOptions(pane = "intersections"), # Assign to the top pane!
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>Intersection ID:</b> ", intersection_id, "<br>",
      "<b>Category:</b> ", category, "<br>",
      "<b>Location:</b> ", location_label, "<br><br>",
      "<b>13/14 Cas:</b> ", start_cas, " | <b>22/23 Cas:</b> ", end_cas, "<br>",
      "<b>Raw Drop:</b> ", raw_reduction, " | <b>% Drop:</b> ", round(pct_reduction, 1), "%<br><br>",
      "<b>Interventions:</b><br>", interventions_str
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # --- LEGENDS  ---
  addLegend(pal = pal_markers, values = top_intersections$category, opacity = 1, title = "Intersections", position = "bottomleft", className = "info legend leg-ints") %>%
  addLegend(pal = pal_raw, values = cd_normalized$raw_reduction, opacity = 0.7, title = "Raw Drop", position = "bottomright", className = "info legend leg-raw") %>%
  addLegend(pal = pal_pct, values = cd_normalized$pct_reduction, opacity = 0.7, title = "% Drop", position = "bottomright", className = "info legend leg-pct") %>%
  addLegend(pal = pal_norm, values = cd_normalized$pct_drop_per_unit_intensity, opacity = 0.7, title = "Norm. Drop", position = "bottomright", className = "info legend leg-norm") %>%
  
  # --- LAYER CONTROLS ---
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("CD: Raw Reduction", "CD: % Reduction", "CD: Normalized Efficacy"),
    overlayGroups = c("Top Intersections"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  
  # --- JAVASCRIPT ---
  htmlwidgets::onRender("
    function(el, x) {
      var map = this;
      
      function updateLegends(layerName) {
        var raw = document.querySelector('.leg-raw');
        var pct = document.querySelector('.leg-pct');
        var norm = document.querySelector('.leg-norm');
        
        if (raw) raw.style.display = (layerName === 'CD: Raw Reduction') ? 'block' : 'none';
        if (pct) pct.style.display = (layerName === 'CD: % Reduction') ? 'block' : 'none';
        if (norm) norm.style.display = (layerName === 'CD: Normalized Efficacy') ? 'block' : 'none';
      }
      
      // Run once on initial load
      updateLegends('CD: Raw Reduction');
      
      // Run every time the radio button is changed
      map.on('baselayerchange', function(e) {
        updateLegends(e.name);
      });
    }
  ")
```
